central_scientific_question: Within Madeira Island, do naturally dry native habitats contribute endemic spider taxa not represented in the same-size native Laurissilva-only forest monitoring portfolio, after equal source COBRA DAY and NIGHT SWEEPING effort? This tests habitat complementarity NOT alien/exotic forest effects.

source.original_study: Malumbres-Olarte et al. 2020 Biodiversity Data Journal 8:e47502, DOI 10.3897/BDJ.8.e47502
source.published_survey_dates: Madeira forest August 2016; dry on Madeira and Porto Santo April 2017
source.method_discrepancy: Forest COBRA aerial+beating+pitfalls and sweeping, dry COBRA ground+day/night sweeping. Forest DAY SWEEP 2 one-hour samples, NIGHT SWEEP 2 one-hour samples; dry DAY SWEEP 4 and NIGHT SWEEP 4. These two methods are the ONLY prospectively comparable core.

design.original_physical_site_unit: Original author plot locationID; 12 forest + 5 Madeira dry, with Porto Santo 5 dry as separate island/secondary. Do not pool Porto Santo dry as independent substitute for Madeira habitat gradient.
design.source_EVent_role: Original Event core exact original site ID, island, date, protocol and effort. Do not choose plot taxa-based.
design.forest_vs_dry_context: Both original habitat classes are naturally occurring vegetation, NOT native-vs-exotic/introduced land cover. No causal forest protection claim.
design.year_season_confound: Native forest sampled August 2016, dry in April 2017; cannot separate habitat from season/year using this original sample; species identity comparisons are descriptive.
design.primary_equal_effort: Within each original plot select exactly TWO 1-hour DAY SWEEP and TWO 1-hour NIGHT SWEEP original Events, using source method labels and lexicographic original coreIDs. Require all 17 Madeira plots pass, otherwise STOP. Dry extra method Events ignored; forest aerial/pitfall/beating/ground sampling excluded.
design.source_plot_habitat: Use original author Event habitat field or author plot key's documented MF vs MD prefix as a source published site label only IF the Event has no explicit habitat term and that prefix grammar is preannounced. Never infer habitat from taxon names or coordinates.
design.metadata_gate: v1.341 source ZIP central directory/meta.xml only, accept original site ID, island, habitat-or-source-plot-code, sample protocol, source taxonomy and author origin field. If origin is absent, do not guess. A separate published author table of status would require a NEW independently frozen crosswalk protocol (not source field rescue).
design.source_event_gate: v1.342 verify source 562 Events, exact 12/5/5 original plots, 2016/17 source dates, each plot two common day/night 1-hour sweep Events. Freeze 68 selected original Event IDs SHA; biological values unopened.
design.future_response_if_gate_passes: v1.343 pre-freeze all 792 possible source 7-of-12 forest baseline panels and 5 added dry (12 total plots) vs 12 forest-only same number of plots. For named endemic taxa, compare observed source endemics covered by each portfolio and how many are unique to dry in Madeira; introduced taxa as negative control. No reweighting by Occurrence count, only site-detected taxa under equal selected Events.
design.interpretation_if_positive: A diverse portfolio of naturally different Madeira habitats captures endemic taxa missed by forest-only monitoring, under source COBRA standardization; not native/exotic forest effect or causal extinction/colonization inference.
design.interpretation_if_negative: No evidence of extra Madeira endemic spider coverage under comparable sweeping; do not change original effort/method to chase positive.
design.original_taxa_from_paper_prior_art: Source authors already reported 34 endemic,26 native,22 introduced across the full survey; these totals and dry/native ecology are prior art, not claimed new discoveries.

quality.statuses: Exact source establishmentMeans or other explicit authoritative original origin metadata; no taxon-name inferencing
quality.stop_policy: Missing original author taxon origin field, imbalanced same-mode effort, physical plot identity mismatch, or source version change -> TERMINAL with zero source taxon read. No relaxing source cohort to improve an effect.
